challenge.method: Tested a qualifying product designed within two years but released later, a timely release by another company, and using publication of NPL 1.1 to reset the period.
challenge.results: V.2 specifies release by Netscape within the period. The start is release of the Original Code. Product design, another company’s release and the edition date do not satisfy those tests.
